description.value:
Named for the Jedi Master who first sought to wed lightsaber philosophy to machine ingenuity, Aqinos treats technology as an extension of the Force rather than a rival to it. Its adherents build and bond with a droid partner, then lean on gadgetry, tech powers, and clever engineering to solve problems a blade alone can't.

Where other forms refine the body or the blade, Aqinos refines the toolkit around them, letting guardian and droid work as a single, adaptable unit that improvises its way past any obstacle.
